title: fix(uninstall): keep going and exit non-zero when pip uninstall fails in clean/uninstall

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+Fix ``pipenv clean`` and ``pipenv uninstall`` aborting with a traceback at the first failing ``pip uninstall`` instead of continuing with the remaining packages and exiting non-zero.

@@ -73,7 +73,9 @@ def remove_extraneous_packages(project, dry_run=False, bare=False, system=False)
                 apparent_bad_package,
                 "-y",
             ]
-            c = run_command(cmd, is_verbose=project.s.is_verbose())
+            c = run_command(
+                cmd, is_verbose=project.s.is_verbose(), catch_exceptions=False
+            )
             if c.returncode != 0:
                 failure = True
     return failure

@@ -38,7 +38,9 @@ def _uninstall_from_environment(project: Project, package, system=False):
             package,
             "-y",
         ]
-        c = run_command(cmd, is_verbose=project.s.is_verbose())
+        c = run_command(
+            cmd, is_verbose=project.s.is_verbose(), catch_exceptions=False
+        )
         console.print(c.stdout, style="cyan")
         if c.returncode != 0:
             console.print(f"Error occurred while uninstalling package {package}.")

@@ -57,3 +57,23 @@ def test_reports_uninstall_failure(clean_project, run_command):
 
     run_command.return_value.returncode = 1
     assert remove_extraneous_packages(clean_project) is True
+
+
+def test_failed_uninstall_does_not_stop_remaining_packages(clean_project, monkeypatch):
+    """The real ``run_command`` raises on a non-zero exit unless told not to."""
+    from pipenv.routines.clean import remove_extraneous_packages
+
+    clean_project.installed_package_names = ["stale-a", "stale-b"]
+    clean_project.lockfile.content = {"default": {}, "develop": {}}
+    attempted = []
+
+    def fake_subprocess_run(command, *args, **kwargs):
+        attempted.append(command[3])
+        return mock.MagicMock(returncode=1, stdout="", stderr="boom")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("pipenv.utils.processes.subprocess_run", fake_subprocess_run)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("pipenv.routines.clean.project_python", lambda *a, **k: "py")
+    monkeypatch.setattr("pipenv.routines.clean.get_runnable_pip", lambda: "pip")
+
+    assert remove_extraneous_packages(clean_project) is True
+    assert attempted == ["stale-a", "stale-b"]

@@ -64,3 +64,17 @@ def test_uninstall_without_virtualenv_explains_the_failure():
     message = print_mock.call_args.args[0]
     assert "No virtualenv found" in message
     assert "requests" in message
+
+
+def test_uninstall_from_environment_reports_failure_instead_of_raising(monkeypatch):
+    """A failing ``pip uninstall`` must give ``False``, not a PipenvCmdError."""
+    project = mock.MagicMock()
+    project.environment.activated.return_value.__enter__.return_value = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr("pipenv.routines.uninstall.project_python", lambda *a, **k: "py")
+    monkeypatch.setattr("pipenv.routines.uninstall.get_runnable_pip", lambda: "pip")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "pipenv.utils.processes.subprocess_run",
+        lambda *a, **k: mock.MagicMock(returncode=1, stdout="", stderr="boom"),
+    )
+
+    assert _uninstall_from_environment(project, "requests") is False
